listings.thesis: Complex PCBs and backplanes for AI servers and networking; tight-supply, direct-AI, underfollowed, 2026-catalyst, hard-to-substitute.
listings.revisionNote: Strategically important, but the stock already rerated; no longer top residual alpha.

priorCase.rankRationale: Genuinely new: June 17 dual European PCB acquisitions (STG/ILFA, accretive Q3 close) plus a fresh $1.0B revolver/$400M TLB and AEC-Q200 qualification expand capacity and end-market reach. Fundamentally positive, but on this crowding-sensitive page the +200% YTD rerating still dominates, so only a small +1 and hold rank 64.
